messages:
Priya Patel: Quick thread — we need to recalibrate RICE for Q3 before Friday. Two competing initiatives: predictive batching (multiple customer asks, 3 pilot commitments) vs adaptive routing (cost reduction + SLA improvements). I pasted my draft scores below; want quick takes so Dani can update the spreadsheet.

Miguel Lopez: For predictive batching I sketched Reach=120 (customers), Impact=6, Confidence=0.7, Effort=4 -> RICE = (120*6*0.7)/4 = 126. Note: I normalized reach to customers, not requests.

Danielle (Dani) Kim: Sales feedback suggests predictive batching gives 2–3x cost reduction for mid-market — that would push Impact to 8. Also infra work may increase Effort.

Miguel Lopez: Good point. If we include KV/cache infra changes, Effort -> 6. Recalc would be (120*8*0.7)/6 = 112. Still competitive but lower.

Samir Chen: Adaptive routing numbers from bench: Reach=15, Impact=4 (latency reduction), Confidence=0.8, Effort=3 -> RICE ~= (15*4*0.8)/3 = 16. It's high impact for latency-sensitive customers but small reach.

Alex Ramos (Sales): Customers with large token volumes explicitly requested batching. 3 LOIs. Predictive batching drives pipeline.

Danielle (Dani) Kim: Proposal: split predictive batching into MVP (prefix-based heuristics + simple KV caching) vs Full Predictor (ML model + telemetry). MVP estimate: Reach=80, Impact=5, Confidence=0.6, Effort=2 -> RICE = (80*5*0.6)/2 = 120. That looks very compelling and quicker to ship.

Priya Patel: Love the split. Launch criteria for MVP: 1) >=20% token cost reduction on 3 pilot tenants, 2) no p99 latency regressions across pilots, 3) documented rollback + feature gate. If MVP passes, schedule Full Predictor as follow-up.

Miguel Lopez: Technical risk: KV invalidation/consistency and increased memory pressure on serving nodes. Need eng-sre validation for eviction policies and monitoring.

eng-oncall-bot: @channel deploy scheduled: predictive-batching/mvp canary -> tomorrow 09:00 UTC :rocket: (CI green, small subset traffic)

Alex Ramos (Sales): Proposed sequencing: MVP -> A/B test on hosted -> if pass, canary full predictor in Dedicated -> then Private. Minimizes blast radius and aligns with customer pilots.

Danielle (Dani) Kim: OK. I’ll update the roadmap sheet with the MVP split and new RICE numbers and notify PMs. Any objections to bumping adaptive routing to Q4? Lower RICE + more infra work.

Samir Chen: Fine to push adaptive routing out but recommend a small spike this quarter to validate kernel-level batching and routing heuristics.

Priya Patel: Thanks all. Dani — please share updated spreadsheet by EOD Thu and tag me. If anyone wants to argue Impact/Confidence numbers, call it out here now. Otherwise we’ll proceed with MVP-first sequencing. :+1:
